QUOTE: By default every field is therefore named `private_<name>`. Code outside the library that writes `ctx->state` gets a compile error... Applications have to define the macro themselves before including any Mbed TLS header.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the two macro branches and states that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS (library, ssl_*2.c) uses real field names, while ordinary consumers get `private_`-prefixed names.
